svg.aria-label: Twelve countries shown as pairs of stacked bars, their diets in 1961 and in the most recent year, as shares of daily calories. Every segment is numbered with its percent, and a bracket under each bar sums the oils, sugar, meat and dairy segments into that plate Western pattern share. That share is 64 for the United States in 1961 and 65 now, but rises from 7 to 54 in South Korea and from 10 to 33 in China, while Nigeria and Senegal barely move. The plates converge toward the Western pattern.
svg.text: Share of daily calories by food group, 1961 (top bar) and the latest year (bottom bar).
Every segment is numbered with its percent of daily calories. The bracket under each bar sums the Western pattern: oils, sugar, meat and dairy.
